R m K A B W g r busy: a one-block GPU DMA (a dark red triangle, four words) started by its store to CHCR2 and the CPU's green quad:
K >= 0 its command word K nops BEHIND that store, K < 0 the command word first and the store -K - 1 nops behind it; m 1 with the
code fetched again (FlushCache). A (2,2): 0008 the triangle; B (98,2): 03e0 the quad as stored; W (34,2): 03e0 only if the quad took
the block's words as its corners. g / r pixels of each colour in the 128 x 8 strip. No assertions.
